synthesizedFacts.fact: Black and brown skin can burn, age from UV exposure, and is vulnerable to skin cancer.
Melanin provides some protection against UV rays but not enough to prevent sun damage.
Mineral sunscreens with clean, non-toxic ingredients are recommended for Black skin to avoid irritation and hormone disruption.
Sunscreens should have an SPF of 30 or higher and provide broad-spectrum protection.
